functions.name: fromRGB8
functions.description: Creates a colour from RGB components in the range 0-255. Alpha is set to 1.

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: The red component of the colour.

parameters.name: g
parameters.description: The green component of the colour.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: The blue component of the colour.

functions.name: fromRGBA8
functions.description: Creates a colour from RGBA components in the range 0-255.

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: The red component of the colour.

parameters.name: g
parameters.description: The green component of the colour.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: The blue component of the colour.

parameters.name: a
parameters.description: The alpha component of the colour.

functions.name: fromHex
functions.description: Creates a colour from a hexadecimal string. Supports `#RGB`, `#RGBA`, `#RRGGBB` and `#RRGGBBAA` formats.

functions.name: toHex
functions.description: Converts a colour to a hexadecimal string.

parameters.name: withAlpha
parameters.description: Whether to include the alpha component (default `true`).

returns.name: hex
returns.description: Colour encoded as an `#RRGGBBAA` hex string (or `#RRGGBB` if `withAlpha` is `false`).

classes.name: Colour
classes.description: RGBA colour stored as an array of four numbers in the 0-1 range (or wider for HDR).
